title: papaver polare
intro: Papaver polare, commonly known as Arctic poppy, is a flowering plant that belongs to the poppy family (Papaveraceae). The plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to provide relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of Papaver polare include alkaloids, such as meconic acid and isothebaine, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including pain relief, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its expectorant properties and ability to soothe coughs.
